caption:
A showroom in zones.

An electronics and appliance showroom organised brand by brand: framed wall bays in charcoal and white, islands on wood-topped plinths, and lines of light that lead visitors through the hall.

Retail interior design & 3D visualization by KAÏRA Interior Design.
